blurb: This check verifies that every virtual SCSI host adapter (vhost) on a VIOS has a live backing device, so the client LPARs mapped to them are actually being served their vSCSI disks. A vhost with no virtual target device, or a target left 'Status Defined' (offline), means a client's disk is not being served — usually left behind by a rebuild or a failed backing hdisk.
